name: Shape of the Beast's Wrath (Protean, Master)

system.description: Spending two Blood Traits triggers a three-turn transformation into a huge, monstrous hybrid form (spending up to five Blood Traits total makes it instant), increasing height by half and tripling weight while adding five Physical Traits, an extra Bruised health level, Heightened Senses, and an extra level of aggravated damage from fangs and claws. The form and its bonus Traits are fixed when the power is learned, but the power may be bought repeatedly for additional forms. While transformed, Social Traits drop by five (minimum one) and you must bid two extra Traits to resist frenzy, without spending Willpower for that resistance.
system.bloodCost: Two Blood Traits (or up to five to speed the change)
